# telnyx_verified_numbers (Data Source)

Lists verified numbers, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_verified_number`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `verified_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--verified_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--verified_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `verified_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `phone_number` (String)
- `record_type` (String) The possible verified numbers record types.
- `verified_at` (String)
